leadText: Nobuhiko Okamoto (Japanese: 岡本信彦 Okamoto Nobuhiko) is a Japanese voice actor for .
plainText:
Nobuhiko Okamoto (Japanese: 岡本信彦 Okamoto Nobuhiko) is a Japanese voice actor for . 

==Biography==
Okamoto was born on October 24, 1986 in , . Okamoto started out his work as for the animated trailer of Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire. His most prominent role in was 's rival, , which he played during . Okamoto is currently affiliated with . He won both the Best Rookie Actor Award and Best Supporting Actor Award during the of 2009 and the of 2011, respectively.
